results.statement: For each observed support S, hat(d)-d = -(I-P_S)d + (hat(d)-P_S d), with Fisher-orthogonal summands and additive squared Fisher error.
results.scope: three-action centered categorical tangent; analytic Fisher projector; undamped empirical-Fisher pseudoinverse
results.verification: exhaustive count-table fixtures and independent score/Fisher accumulation

results.statement: Exact action-support probabilities follow inclusion-exclusion; cell absence is (1-q_a)^N and rank deficiency for three actions is sum_a(q_0+q_a)^N-2q_0^N.
results.scope: fixed-N joint multinomial sampling with interior action probabilities

results.statement: For independent finite-moment shadows with common nonzero mean m, disjoint-half Fisher cosine converges almost surely to one regardless of cos_F(m,d).
results.scope: positive-definite Fisher metric on the tested tangent and nonzero estimator mean
results.falsification: a counterexample satisfying the scope where either half mean does not converge to m or continuity of cosine fails

results.statement: Adding c to all rewards preserves the analytic centered tangent but changes the plug-in expectation by c E[hat(F)^+ bar(s)] in general.
results.scope: raw deterministic rewards with no fitted baseline and true-policy empirical scores
results.implication: N p_min, support probabilities, and Fisher spectrum alone cannot determine angular bias

results.statement: A nonvacuous angular-bias bound should combine exact support-loss mass with full-rank whitened perturbation terms involving empirical Fisher deviation and score/reward residual.
results.scope: open after ACL-006; any compact bound must distinguish context/action support factorization and include reward/baseline geometry
results.evidence: ACL-006 exactly falsified N p_min-only and support-plus-Fisher-spectrum-only reductions while confirming the full finite multinomial prediction
